capabilities: Delete nested LaTeX structures as complete units
Jump the cursor along the math parse tree
Apply smart input rules for math
Render inline math in real time
extras: Active only inside math regions; supports Obsidian 1.4.0 and above and mobile.
motivation: Built to avoid the rule conflicts and nesting limits of regex-based LaTeX editing.
problem: Regex-based LaTeX editing in Obsidian struggles with deeply nested math and can interfere with prose and IME input.
summary: Structure-aware LaTeX math editor that deletes, navigates and expands expressions using a parse tree.
